Helldivers Mobilize! is a Standard Warbond automatically available for free in the Warbonds tab of the Acquisition Center.

Overview

Players can use Medals, a form of in-game currency, to claim various items, including 6 Boosters, 14 weapons, 10 armors, 20 cosmetics, and 750 Super Credits. These rewards are spread across 10 pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 1 to 150). Cadets start on page one, unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options.
